edits.replace:
# Pinned: this job holds a PyPI OIDC token (id-token: write, environment: pypi),
      # so an unpinned install would run unreviewed code beside publishing rights.
      # tests/requirements.txt is already hash-pinned for exactly this reason; ruff
      # was the gap. Pinned identically in ci.yml so lint cannot differ by version.
      - name: Install ruff
        run: pip install ruff==0.16.5
